description: Na₆Mo₁₀O₃₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.97 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.64 Å. There are five inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.37 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.36 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-2.38 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.16 Å. In the fifth Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-2.28 Å. There are seventeen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Mo atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Mo atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMo₃ tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Mo atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMo₃ tetrahedra. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and two Mo atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Mo atoms. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Mo atoms.
